package app_test

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql/handler"
	"github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql/handler/transport"
	_ "modernc.org/sqlite"

	"example.com/app/graph"
	"github.com/syssam/velox"
	"github.com/syssam/velox/contrib/graphql/veloxgql"
)

// rows is the number of rows of each table.
const rows = 500

// benchServe is the schema on a seeded in-memory database, through gqlgen's handler
// and the extension, and a function that sends a query to it.
func benchServe(b *testing.B) func(q string, vars map[string]any) string {
	b.Helper()
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file::memory:?_pragma=foreign_keys(0)")
	if err != nil {
		b.Fatal(err)
	}
	b.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
	db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	tx, _ := db.Begin()
	for _, s := range ddl {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(s); err != nil {
			b.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		for k := 4; k <= rows; k++ {
			if i%10 != 0 {
				if _, err := tx.Exec(fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO e%ds (id, name, amount, created_at, prev_id) VALUES (%d, 'e%d-r%d', %d.5, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', %d)", i, k, i, k, k, k)); err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else if _, err := tx.Exec(fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO e%ds (id, name, amount, created_at) VALUES (%d, 'e%d-r%d', %d.5, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')", i, k, i, k, k)); err != nil {
				b.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		b.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := handler.New(graph.NewExecutableSchema(graph.Config{Resolvers: &graph.Resolver{}}))
	srv.Use(veloxgql.NewExtension(velox.Open(velox.SQLite, db)))
	srv.AddTransport(transport.POST{})
	return func(q string, vars map[string]any) string {
		body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"query": q, "variables": vars})
		req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/", strings.NewReader(string(body)))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		srv.ServeHTTP(w, req)
		return w.Body.String()
	}
}

// run times query q, which must succeed.
func run(b *testing.B, q string, vars map[string]any) {
	do := benchServe(b)
	if out := do(q, vars); strings.Contains(out, `"errors"`) {
		b.Fatalf("%s", out)
	}
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		do(q, vars)
	}
}

func BenchmarkList50(b *testing.B) {
	run(b, `{ e1s(first: 50) { edges { cursor node { id name amount createdAt } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }`, nil)
}

func BenchmarkList50Count(b *testing.B) {
	run(b, `{ e1s(first: 50, orderBy: {field: NAME, direction: DESC}) { totalCount edges { node { id name } } } }`, nil)
}

func BenchmarkNested(b *testing.B) {
	run(b, `{ e2s(first: 50) { edges { node { id name prev { id name } next(first: 5) { edges { node { id name } } } } } } }`, nil)
}

func BenchmarkWhere(b *testing.B) {
	run(b, `{ e3s(first: 20, where: {or: [{nameContains: "r1"}, {nameHasPrefix: "e3-r2"}], not: {nameIn: ["e3-r1","e3-r2"]}}) { edges { node { id name } } } }`, nil)
}

func BenchmarkNode(b *testing.B) {
	run(b, `query($id: ID!) { node(id: $id) { ... on E4 { id name amount } } }`, map[string]any{"id": veloxgql.EncodeID("E4", int64(7))})
}

func BenchmarkNodes20(b *testing.B) {
	ids := make([]string, 20)
	for i := range ids {
		ids[i] = veloxgql.EncodeID("E4", int64(i+1))
	}
	run(b, `query($ids: [ID!]!) { nodes(ids: $ids) { ... on E4 { id name amount } } }`, map[string]any{"ids": ids})
}
